BABY BRAIN STEP-BY-STEP (5 minutes)
Walk through each card one by one. For each one, pause and connect it to AI:
STEP 1 (Cat): "Baby sees a cat. No context. Just raw data — pixels of colour and shape. AI starts the same way. Raw data. No meaning yet."
STEP 2 (Dog mistake): "Baby calls a dog a cat! Parent says NO. That NO is a training signal. In AI language, we call it a correction, or a 'loss signal.' It tells the AI: you were wrong, adjust."
STEP 3 (1000 examples): "After 1000 cats, 1000 corrections — baby now gets it. AI does this with 1 million, sometimes 1 billion examples. That's why it needs so much data."
STEP 4 (AI same way): "So here's the secret. AI is not magic. AI is a learner. Just like you. Just like that baby."
Then point to the bottom bar and say it out loud: SAY: "Write this down if you want to remember one thing from today: Data is AI's childhood. Corrections are its parents. Repetition is its school."
CHECK FOR UNDERSTANDING (Icebreaker #1): SAY: "Raise your hand if you can explain Machine Learning to your dadi or nani using a cooking analogy. Just a cooking analogy. Go." Pick 2 students. Their answers will be brilliant. Affirm the best one loudly.
